methodology.status: Estimated editorial study bands, not certified CEFR vocabulary levels.
methodology.review: Each listed native lemma and exact dictionary sense was inspected individually in the source snapshot. The judgments consider target-language register, lexical specificity, idiomaticity or specialist conceptual knowledge. A shared concept can receive different bands or no assignment in different languages.
methodology.independence: No English CEFR labels, rank thresholds, HSK/JLPT/TOPIK conversions or quotas were used. In particular, ordinary native translations of rare English words were not promoted merely because the English headword is advanced.
methodology.C1: Advanced abstract, evaluative, cultural and professional vocabulary usable in sustained discussion.
methodology.C2: Marked learned/literary native lexical choices or tightly specialised senses requiring precision beyond general advanced discourse. This is a study-placement judgment, not evidence that all proficient speakers know every specialist term.
methodology.limitations: Model-assisted editorial judgments have not been independently validated by native-speaker educators or an empirical CEFR study. Homonymous everyday senses must not inherit these levels. Existing published source classifications take precedence.
methodology.matching: Apply only when conceptId, target language, normalized current lemma and exact meaning all match. Lemmas remove Russian combining stress marks but preserve ё and й.

assignments.reason: скрупулёзный: Precise character/process adjective for painstaking attention to detail; advanced descriptive vocabulary with a distinct positive or critical nuance.

assignments.meaning: apparent contradiction which is nonetheless true
assignments.reason: парадокс: Abstract noun for an apparently contradictory truth; advanced reasoning vocabulary beyond a simple factual contradiction.

assignments.meaning: the power, right, or authority to interpret and apply the law
assignments.reason: юрисдикция: Legal authority to interpret and apply law; an advanced institutional sense, including the specialised legal meaning of Portuguese competência.
хладнокровие: Native compound noun for composure under stress; sophisticated character vocabulary but less restricted than the learned Romance equivalents.
сюрреализм: Art-critical movement name involving a specific aesthetic concept; advanced cultural vocabulary rather than everyday description.

assignments.meaning: any of several styles of art, architecture, literature, philosophy, etc., that flourished in the 20th century
assignments.reason: модернизм: Established learned name of a twentieth-century cultural movement; appropriate to advanced discussion of art and intellectual history.

assignments.meaning: done or made in silence; implied, but not expressed; silent
assignments.reason: негласный: Formal adjective for something understood without explicit statement; advanced pragmatic or institutional use.
добросовестный: Nuanced character adjective for careful, responsible attention to obligations; formal descriptive vocabulary beyond a general good or careful.
присущий: Abstract relational adjective for an inherent quality; productive in advanced explanation and argument, not merely physical interior position.

assignments.meaning: use of a word or phrase to replace another word with one considered less offensive
assignments.reason: эвфемизм: Rhetorical/metalinguistic term for replacing a potentially offensive expression; requires nuanced discussion of register and meaning.
осмотрительный: Precise character adjective for prudent awareness of consequences; advanced descriptive use.
аллюзия: Literary/communicative term for an indirect reference; requires interpretation beyond the literal expression.
эрудированный: Learned adjective for extensive scholarly knowledge; an advanced register-specific distinction from the ordinary knowledgeable.
великодушный: Native adjective for noble generosity of spirit; advanced moral description without requiring the marked Romance literary register.
стоицизм: Name of the philosophical school; advanced cultural-discussion vocabulary, distinct from an everyday stoical attitude.
аксиома: Mathematical foundational-assumption term; established academic vocabulary requiring an abstract concept, without implying every mathematical term is C2.

assignments.meaning: impossible to prevent or stop — see also inevitable
assignments.reason: неотвратимый: Formal descriptive adjective for an unavoidable course or force; a nuanced advanced equivalent of inevitability.
гипербола: Rhetorical-device term for deliberate exaggeration; advanced analytical vocabulary, with the geometrical homonym excluded.

assignments.meaning: based on individual discretion or judgment
assignments.reason: произвольный: Abstract evaluative adjective for a decision based on individual discretion; requires distinction from random and other nearby meanings.

assignments.meaning: selecting a mixture of what appear to be best of various doctrines, methods or styles
assignments.reason: эклектичный: Learned adjective for selecting from different doctrines or styles; advanced artistic/intellectual description rather than the generic mixed.
недвусмысленный: Formal adjective or phrase for a completely unambiguous statement; useful in advanced argument and precise interpretation.

assignments.meaning: use of symbols which may be interpreted to reveal a hidden, broader message about real-world issues and occurrences; the interpretation of such symbols
assignments.reason: аллегория: Literary-analysis term for a sustained symbolic representation; an established abstract artistic concept.

assignments.meaning: claim, pretense, or false representation of holding beliefs, feelings, or virtues that one does not actually possess
assignments.reason: лицемерие: Abstract moral/social noun describing a discrepancy between professed values and conduct; nuanced evaluative vocabulary.

assignments.meaning: proposition that is opposite to other proposition
assignments.reason: антитеза: Learned argumentative term for an opposing proposition; suited to advanced abstract discussion rather than routine conversation.
конфирмация: Denominational religious term naming the rite of confirmation; a restricted borrowing rather than everyday подтверждение.

assignments.meaning: lasting for a short period of time
assignments.reason: эфемерный: Learned literary adjective for something fleeting or insubstantial; the borrowed native form is markedly less ordinary than недолговечный.
кольцо: This familiar-looking native noun denotes the abstract algebraic structure with two operations; the ring-jewellery sense is explicitly outside this judgment.

assignments.meaning: nautical: device for measuring the speed of a vessel
assignments.reason: лаг: Specialist nautical instrument noun for measuring a vessel's speed; this is not an everyday record or logbook sense.
развёртка: Geometric net of connected polygons that folds into a solid; the specialist construction sense is separate from ordinary unrolling.

assignments.meaning: nautical: tapered timber from which square sails hang
assignments.reason: рея: Technical nautical name of the spar supporting a square sail; uncommon outside sailing and maritime texts.
предосудительный: Marked formal evaluative adjective expressing moral blameworthiness; a precise literary/legal-register choice.
бом-брамсель: Precisely named upper square sail in traditional nautical terminology; a narrow current specialist vocabulary item.
солипсизм: Technical philosophical name for the doctrine that only one's own mind can be known; a restricted specialist concept, not an everyday word for selfishness.

assignments.meaning: element of the predicate of a sentence which supplements the subject or object by means of the verb
assignments.reason: именная часть составного сказуемого: Specialist grammatical constituent complementing a subject or object through a linking verb; requires analysis of predicative structure.
схоластика: Specialist history-of-philosophy term for the scholastic school and method; requires knowledge of the doctrine rather than the everyday idea of studying.
неправоспособность: Formal legal noun for absence of legal capacity; a restricted legal concept distinct from ordinary disability or lack of skill.

assignments.meaning: one who selects by the eclectic method
assignments.reason: эклектик: Learned noun naming a practitioner of the eclectic method; specialist intellectual-history vocabulary rather than a general mixed style.
трансляция: Specialist molecular-biology use for protein synthesis from messenger RNA; distinct from the ordinary language-translation or broadcasting senses.
приложение: Technical grammatical use for an appositional construction; this assignment excludes ordinary attachment/application meanings of homonymous forms.

assignments.meaning: passing or disappearing with time; transitory
assignments.reason: преходящий: Literary adjective for what passes away with time; distinguishes the elevated native form from ordinary временный.
спин: Quantum-mechanical angular momentum terminology; the specialist native borrowing or sense is not the everyday act of spinning.

assignments.meaning: linear algebra: sum of the diagonal elements of a square matrix
assignments.reason: след: Linear-algebra sense naming the sum of a square matrix's diagonal entries; ordinary trail or mark meanings do not motivate this estimate.

assignments.meaning: mathematics (algebra): a commutative ring satisfying the field axioms
assignments.reason: поле: Restricted abstract-algebra sense of a field, a commutative division structure; native everyday body/field senses do not receive this assignment.
цепь: Specialist genetics sense of a nucleotide strand; the familiar native material-thread or chain meanings do not determine this assignment.
